fact: Leaving the track without a justifiable reason multiple times.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. The car left the track on six (6) occasions without justifiable reason, after having received 5 second time penalties on the fourth (4th) and fifth (5th) occasions.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 10 Leaving The Track Multiple Times Third
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
